page_title: FIO 3-0 INT | Fiorentina v Inter 06/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick.
90+5' The shots on goal statistics – 6:2.
90+4' Maat Caprini (Fiorentina) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maat Caprini (Fiorentina) will replace Moise Kean.
90+1' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) replaces Lucas Beltran.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 0 GOAL! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 3:0.
88' Substitution. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) has come on for Robin Gosens.
88' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
83' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Davide Frattesi will be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Carlos Augusto as he is replaced by Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
82' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
80' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Dodo (Fiorentina) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
77' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Yann Sommer and he's equal to it.

76' Federico Dimarco (Inter) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by David de Gea!
73' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' A poor finish by Nicolo Barella (Inter) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
72' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marko Arnautovic (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
69' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Nicolo Barella (Inter).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco (Inter) replaces Alessandro Bastoni.
69' Daniele Doveri rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Moise Kean (Fiorentina).

68' 2 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Dodo finds Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Yann Sommer had no chance of stopping that. 2:0.
66' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

62' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
60' The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
59' 1 - 0 Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom left corner.
59' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
57' The percentage of ball possession is – 33:67.
56' The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.

54' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.

51' Dodo races towards the box before laying off to Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
49' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
47' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
46' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Dangerous play by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina). Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Marcus Thuram (Inter) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
45' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
43' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him. Inter win a corner.

39' A precise short pass from Moise Kean releases Dodo (Fiorentina) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

34' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
32' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Inter players look gutted.
31' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
30' Carlos Augusto (Inter) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.

30' Davide Frattesi (Inter) meets a fine cross inside the penalty area from the resulting free kick and attempts to beat the keeper with a sweet header. That he does, but one of the defenders standing on the goal line manages to stop the effort going into the middle of the target. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
30' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
28' The referee blows his whistle as Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge. Inter win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
22' A cross from a corner kick by Inter is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

22' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
21' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
20' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).
20' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but David de Gea was alert and made a comfortable save. Inter have a corner.
17' The match can continue after the interruption.
17' Substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
17' The game has come to an end for Nicolo Barella. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Davide Frattesi (Inter).
17' Here comes a substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Edoardo Bove.
17' Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
17' Substitution. Yacine Adli walks off the pitch and Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
17' It will be a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Danilo Cataldi walks off.
17' The match is abandoned!
17' The game is interrupted.
16' The game is interrupted. Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) suffers a horrific injury!
12' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
10' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
9' Corner kick. Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is ready to send the ball into the box.
8' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) trips an opposition player and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
7' Some neat passing and movement from Inter as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
6' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Moise Kean (Fiorentina), but the defence gets it clear.
5' The opposition back off Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!

2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
